title: 过去完成时·过去的过去

questions.stem: When I woke up this morning, it ____ (stop) raining.

options.distractor: 雨停发生在我醒来之前

questions.explanation: 雨在我醒来之前就停了，用 had stopped。

questions.stem: He ____ (eat) all the cakes before I came in.

options.distractor: 吃蛋糕发生在我进来之前

questions.explanation: 我进来之前他就吃完了，用 had eaten。

questions.stem: The bus ____ (go) when we got to the stop.

options.distractor: 车开走在我们到达之前

questions.explanation: 我们到站时车已经开走了，用 had gone。

questions.stem: She said she ____ (see) the film before.

options.distractor: “之前看过”是比 said 更早的事
主句是过去时，参照点在过去

questions.explanation: “她说她以前看过”，看过发生在说之前，用 had seen。

options.text: The train had left when we arrived.
He had finished the work before dinner.
They have gone home when I called.
She had read the book before the class.

questions.explanation: called 是过去参照点，应改为 They had gone home when I called。

questions.stem: — Why didn't you see the film? — Because I ____ (see) it twice.

options.distractor: “看过两次”发生在“没去看”之前
没去看是过去的事，参照点在过去

questions.explanation: 解释过去为什么没去：之前已经看过两次，用 had seen。
